title.purpose: Card titles, table names, form rows.

body.purpose: Descriptions and settings text, 1.75 line height.

label.purpose: Table heads and nav group labels in brass, 12px semibold.

reading.purpose: Measured values; 28px in cards, 48px in device detail, 44px on the dial.

code.purpose: Endpoints, tokens, editor and terminal in the Menlo/Consolas stack.

shadows.name: double-keyline
shadows.purpose: Inner hairline that makes a plate read as engraved.

motion.name: dial-sweep
motion.purpose: Needle sweeps from -150deg to its value once on mount; the only choreographed motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled brass action, one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brass, #c9a05a); color: #150f04; border: 1px solid var(--brass, #c9a05a); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -8px #000c; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); border-color: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined brass-shadow button for ordinary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: transparent; color: var(--bone, #efe7d5); border: 1px solid var(--brass-lo, #7d653a); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--plate-hi, #182b47); border-color: var(--brass, #c9a05a); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Recessed well input with brass focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--well, #0a1424); color: var(--bone, #efe7d5); border: 1px solid rgba(201,160,90,.14); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; caret-color: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--brass-lo, #7d653a); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--brass, #c9a05a); outline: 2px solid var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar entry; the active one carries a brass diamond marker at the inline end.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 220px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: none; color: var(--text-2, #b4bfce); font-size: 15px; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--plate, #12223a); color: var(--bone, #efe7d5); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--plate-hi, #182b47); color: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,160,90,.3); } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-inline-start: auto; background: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Plate
components.description: Raised surface with double brass keyline.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--plate, #12223a); color: var(--bone, #efe7d5); border: 1px solid rgba(201,160,90,.3); border-radius: 4px; padding: 22px 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #12223a, inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(201,160,90,.14), 0 14px 26px -16px #000c; } .ds-plate h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-plate p { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-3, #8e9db2); }

components.name: Status Marks
components.description: Shape-coded status: circle, triangle, open circle, struck circle.
components.html: OnlineWarningOfflineRevoked
components.css: .ds-status-set { display: flex; gap: 18px; color: #efe7d5; font-size: 13px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-status i { width: 10px; height: 10px; display: inline-block; } .ds-online i { background: #52b8a3; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-warning i { background: #eaa53b; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-offline i, .ds-revoked i { border: 1.5px solid #8e9db2; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-revoked i { background: linear-gradient(to top right, transparent calc(50% - .75px), #8e9db2 calc(50% - .75px) calc(50% + .75px), transparent calc(50% + .75px)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Recessed track with one selected plate segment.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: var(--well, #0a1424); border: 1px solid rgba(201,160,90,.14); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-seg button { padding: 5px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: var(--text-2, #b4bfce); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--bone, #efe7d5); } .ds-seg button.selected { background: var(--plate-hi, #182b47); color: var(--brass-hi, #e2bd7b); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,160,90,.3); }

components.name: Readout Row
components.description: Ledger row: label column and value, hairline divided; used instead of KPI cards.
components.css: .ds-ledger { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,160,90,.14); color: #efe7d5; } .ds-ledger > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 170px auto; justify-content: start; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,160,90,.14); } .ds-ledger dt { font-size: 14px; color: #b4bfce; } .ds-ledger dd { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Wasl is a working instrument, not a dashboard. A deep lapis-ink ground carries raised plates edged with double brass keylines, like a stamped plate on a bench meter. There is one accent, brass, and it is spent on interaction, table heads, readings and the single dial. Everything else is lapis and bone-white.

The system is Arabic first. Layout is written with logical properties so right-to-left and left-to-right render as mirror images. Code, endpoints and the editor are the only forced-LTR islands.

Status is always a shape, never color alone. Density is calm and ledger-like. Motion is a single event, the dial needle sweeping to its value once on mount.
keyCharacteristics: Lapis-ink ground, raised plates, double brass keylines as the only ornament.
One accent (brass); teal, amber and coral are reserved for status.
Status carried by shape: circle, triangle, open circle, struck circle.
One typeface family (Noto Sans Arabic) plus system mono for code.
Reduced motion switches off all transitions and animation.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only accent. A second accent hue for decoration is never introduced; teal, amber and coral mean status and nothing else.

rules.name: The Shape Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every status carries a distinct shape. Color reinforces the shape and never replaces it.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: With one family, rank by weight and size (700 / 600 / 400) and by color step. Do not add a second decorative face without a decision recorded here.

rules.name: The Bundled Face Rule
rules.body: Arabic text uses the bundled Noto Sans Arabic; do not depend on an installed or remote font.

rules.name: The Keyline Rule
rules.body: Raised means a brass keyline border plus an inset hairline; shadow is secondary and always soft, blurred and offset downward, never a hard offset.

dos: Do write layout with logical properties so RTL and LTR mirror each other; flip directional glyphs under html[dir=ltr].
Do pair every status color with its shape mark.
Do build raised surfaces from Plate, a Keyline border and an inset hairline.
Do use Brass Highlight for hover, selection, focus and readings; Brass for heads and fills.
Do keep Noto Sans Arabic bundled and tabular numerals on.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; the dial sweep is the only choreographed motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or use status hues decoratively.
Don't signal state by color alone.
Don't use hard offset shadows or bright glows; shadows stay soft and downward.
Don't turn readouts into card grids of large KPI tiles.
Don't use physical left and right in layout, except in the code and editor islands that are LTR by design.
Don't rely on an installed or remote font for Arabic.
